_comment: Personas are interest profiles. 'categories' is used ONLY by build_personas.py to derive ground truth from real MIND users whose click history is dominated (>=70%) by these categories. Category labels are NEVER shown to retrieval or to the LLM; they only see 'name' and 'description'. Descriptions are written as reader-facing prose (no developer notes) on purpose.

personas.name: Sports Fanatic
personas.description: Lives for game day. Wants scores, recaps, trades, injuries, playoff races and news about their favorite teams and athletes.

personas.name: Markets & Money Reader
personas.description: Follows the economy and personal finances: stock market moves, company earnings, interest rates, savings, taxes and retirement planning.

personas.name: Foodie
personas.description: Loves eating and cooking. Interested in restaurants, recipes, chefs, food trends, drinks and what is new on the menu.

personas.name: Travel Planner
personas.description: Always planning the next trip. Wants destination ideas, airline and hotel news, travel tips and things to do around the world.

personas.name: Wellness Reader
personas.description: Cares about staying healthy: medical research, nutrition, fitness, mental health, diseases and what doctors recommend.

personas.name: Lifestyle & Home Reader
personas.description: Interested in everyday living: home and garden, relationships, fashion, parenting, money-saving tips and ways to improve daily life.

personas.name: Car Enthusiast
personas.description: Obsessed with cars and trucks: new model reviews, electric vehicles, recalls, car-buying advice, motorsport and classic cars.

personas.name: TV & Movie Buff
personas.description: Keeps up with what to watch: TV shows, series finales, streaming releases, movie reviews, box office and trailers.

personas.name: Music & Celebrity Follower
personas.description: Follows musicians and famous people: new albums, concerts, award shows, celebrity news and pop culture moments.

personas.name: Current Affairs Follower
personas.description: Wants to stay informed about the day's top stories: politics, government, crime, courts, major national events and breaking news.

personas.name: Weather & Daily Planner
personas.description: Checks the forecast before planning the day: storms, severe weather alerts, temperatures and seasonal conditions.

personas.name: Broad Generalist
personas.description: Reads a little of everything: top headlines, big sports stories and lifestyle pieces, without one strong passion.
